SELECT f.favorite_id AS favorite_id, v.video_id AS video_id, v.title AS title, v.description AS description, v.video_img_url AS video_img_url, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(v.duration, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '00:00:00') AS duration, u.user_id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.img_url AS author_avatar_url, v.view_count AS view_count, v.like_count AS like_count, f.favorite_date AS favorite_date FROM favorites f INNER JOIN videos v ON f.video_id = v.video_id AND v.enable = 1 INNER JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1
AND (v.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.nickname ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY f.favorite_date DESC

SELECT v.video_id AS video_id, v.user_id AS user_id, v.title AS title, v.description AS description, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(v.duration, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '00:00:00') AS duration, v.upload_date AS upload_date, v.video_src_url AS video_src_url, v.video_img_url AS video_img_url, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.img_url AS author_avatar_url, c.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, v.view_count AS view_count, v.like_count AS like_count, v.favorite_count AS favorite_count, v.barrage_count AS barrage_count, v.comment_count AS comment_count, v.review_status AS review_status FROM favorites f INNER JOIN videos v ON f.video_id = v.video_id AND v.enable = 1 INNER JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN video_categories vc ON v.video_id = vc.video_id AND vc.enable = 1 LEFT JOIN categories c ON vc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1 ORDER BY f.favorite_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
